description: Electric Vehicle Charging Dataset is a dataset listed in Open Energy Hub (ORNL), an energy-sector data hub, published or maintained by Oak Ridge National Laboratory for the U.S. DOE Office of Electricity. This electric vehicle (EV) charging dataset includes the EV connection time, charging duration, energy consumption, and day number each corresponding respectively to connectionTimedecimal, chargingDuration, kWhDelivered, dayIndicator columns in the dataset for an EV charging parking lot. Coverage: the United States. The portal files it under Transportation, Spatial planning, Town planning, Buildings, Equipment, Housing. Its keywords are electric vehicles, artificial intelligence, machine learning, generative adversarial network, generative artificial intelligence. The portal shows 2024-04-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oeh-open-data-portal.
